basics.description:
**ANY.RUN TI Feeds for Microsoft Defender for Endpoint** imports fresh ANY.RUN indicators (IP addresses, domains, URLs, file hashes and certificate thumbprints) into Microsoft Defender for Endpoint on a schedule.

The deployment creates a Function App (Flex Consumption), a Logic App, a Storage Account and Application Insights in the selected resource group.

Each deployment creates a new instance; all its resources share the instance name. To update an existing instance, enter its instance name on this page.

basics.name: instanceName
basics.label: Instance name
basics.toolTip: Used in the names of all resources of this deployment. Keep the suggested random value to create a new instance, or enter the name of an existing instance to update it. Up to 12 lowercase letters and digits.

constraints.validationMessage: Use up to 12 lowercase letters and digits.

options.text: All resources of this deployment are named after the instance name, for example anyrun-feeds-mde-<instance name>-la. A random name is suggested, so this deployment creates a new instance. To update an existing instance, replace it with that instance's name (see the Instance tag on its resources; "default" means the field was left empty).

Each TI Feeds instance must use its own app registration. An instance removes indicators created by its client ID that are not in its own feed, so two instances sharing one app registration overwrite each other.

The selected region has not been confirmed as supporting Azure Functions Flex Consumption. Wait for the region list to load. If this message persists, check Microsoft.Web access or choose another region.

Create an app registration in Microsoft Entra ID and grant it the WindowsDefenderATP application permissions Ti.Read.All, Ti.ReadWrite and Ti.ReadWrite.All with admin consent. Then create a client secret and enter the values below. Click here for step-by-step instructions.

elements.name: tenantId
elements.label: Directory (tenant) ID
elements.toolTip: Tenant ID of the Microsoft Entra directory that contains the app registration.

elements.name: clientId
elements.label: Application (client) ID
elements.toolTip: Application (client) ID of the app registration.

validations.message: Flex Consumption support for the selected region has not been confirmed. Return to Basics and wait for the region list, check Microsoft.Web access, or choose another region.

elements.name: clientSecret
elements.toolTip: Value (not the ID) of the client secret created for the app registration.

constraints.validationMessage: The client secret must be at least 12 characters.

elements.name: indicatorAction
elements.label: Indicator action
elements.toolTip: Response action applied to indicators created in Defender for Endpoint.

options.text: An ANY.RUN TI Feeds API key is required. Contact your ANY.RUN account manager or request a demo to get one.

elements.name: apiKey
elements.toolTip: ANY.RUN API key with access to TI Feeds.

constraints.validationMessage: The API key must be at least 12 characters.

elements.name: intervalRecurrence
elements.label: Import interval (hours)
elements.toolTip: How often the Logic App imports the feed.

elements.name: feedFetchDepth
elements.label: Feed depth (days)
elements.toolTip: How many days back to fetch indicators.

elements.name: minimumConfidence
elements.label: Minimum confidence
elements.toolTip: Import only indicators with confidence greater than or equal to this value.

elements.name: workspaceMode
elements.label: Log Analytics workspace
elements.toolTip: Application Insights for the Function App stores its data in a Log Analytics workspace.

elements.name: workspace
elements.label: Existing workspace
elements.toolTip: Select an existing Log Analytics workspace.
